purpose: Record the bounded Milestone B deterministic GitHub App witness-publication and full provider-fingerprint readback invariants layered on the hardened producer without claiming bootstrap authority, founder-final approval, merge authority, deployment authority, live provider enforcement, secret installation, or runtime trigger activation.

claims: src/review/deterministicReviewProducer.ts must classify the executable FCR merge-authentication chain as deterministic trust root: founder authentication/session authority, portfolio-switch gating/state resolution, V10 privileged capability validation, V10 decision authority, founder-control decision binding, approvals execution, and the server mount; changes to those paths must produce P1 trust-root-self-modification instead of self-certification.

src/review/deterministicReviewProducer.ts must cover direct merge-authority decision modules as well as middleware wrappers, including founderSession, switchboard store, capabilityKernel, v10DecisionAuthorityGate, and founderControlDecision, while avoiding a transitive trust-root expansion into generic storage or transport clients.

src/review/deterministicReviewWitnessPublisher.ts may publish only a clear deterministic receipt produced from provider-observed PR/base/head/diff truth through the repository provider's narrow witness capability, must bind pre/post publication PR identity and exact head, and must reject success unless provider readback reports the exact derived signal, the full receipt reviewHash as evidenceFingerprint, and the server-owned numeric GITHUB_APP_ID.

src/review/independentReviewGate.ts must treat a founder-final deterministic witness as current only when exact head, receipt-derived signal name, passed status, trusted GitHub App issuer, and the provider-backed full evidenceFingerprint all match the exact deterministic review receipt; missing or same-prefix-but-different full fingerprints fail closed.

src/providers/DeterministicReviewGitHubProvider.ts must restrict deterministic witness publication to the canonical Founder Control Room repository and exact success-only Check Run shape, must reject malformed or substituted head SHA, review hash, derived signal name, or bounded summary before provider mutation, must reject a noncanonical GitHub API base in the normal runtime writer path, and must preserve GitHub Check Run external_id as the full evidenceFingerprint on provider readback.

src/providers/RepositoryProvider.ts exposes only a narrow optional deterministic-review witness publication capability rather than ambient generic Check Run authority, carries an optional provider-backed evidenceFingerprint for exact evidence correlation, and requires consumers to fail closed when a load-bearing fingerprint or witness capability is unavailable.

src/providers/providerFactory.ts must expose deterministic review witness publication for Founder Control Room only when GITHUB_APP_ID plus GITHUB_PRIVATE_KEY mint the repository-scoped GitHub App installation token; a local or development GITHUB_TOKEN fallback cannot mint deterministic review evidence, and a partial GitHub App credential pair must fail closed even when a fallback token is present.
